environment: local, Windows 11, Node v24.18.0, loopback Docker PostgreSQL, master_saas_test prepared by db:test:prepare
notes: 20 of the original 24 failures are fixed at the cause. The remaining 4 are RC-4, a product defect classified R4 and excluded from this approval; they are reported, not weakened.
The suite total rose 1916 to 1920: ST-002, REG-004 and the two split POSIX cases. No test was deleted and no assertion loosened.

Three defects were found by this work that nobody was looking for: psql rejects Prisma ?schema= as a URI parameter; Node refuses to spawn npx.cmd with shell false; and prisma.permission.upsert races on an empty catalogue. All three only appear on the platform or the empty database this specification exists to make deterministic.

One correction of my own is recorded rather than hidden: the first Playwright readiness probe gated on a route with a dynamic slug, which returns a legitimate 404 for an unknown workspace. It hung for its deadline and failed run 3 of the first five-run check. Corrected, then 5 of 5.
Residual: the two POSIX mode assertions never execute on this workstation. EVC-014 claims CI runs Linux, which is DOCUMENTED rather than measured from here.
